attribution.note: Marcus states this contrast in his own argument, outside the Hinton quotation.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves the clinical exception and qualitative frequency claim. In context, wholesale fabrication means unintended invention, excluding lies, jokes and ordinary errors.

contract.note: The contract reasonably operationalizes the contextual meaning, preserves the qualitative comparison and requires comparable evidence without inventing a numerical threshold.

evidence.note: The dated study establishes recurring invention of nonexistent citations by contemporary models. It supports the LLM component only; it provides no comparable human rate.

The review establishes experimentally induced false memories in humans. These induction rates neither measure everyday prevalence nor contradict the qualified claim that wholesale invention is unusual.
The benchmark is correctly described and predates the claim, but its broader truthfulness metric does not isolate substantial unintended invention or establish the required comparison.

reviews.rationale: The packet supports recurrent LLM citation fabrication but does not establish how unusual comparable unintended invention is among humans outside the clinical exception. Induced false memories and broad truthfulness scores do not settle that comparison. Partial support without contradictory findings does not establish a mixed outcome.
